skim.know_text: Haven't seen the data, don't know device by name, however I assume ABA because I know almost all measured devices have been.
skim.skim_impression: Not clear to me why it's doing what it's doing as soon as it introduces magnetic field (ana19 and beyond).

final.overall_read: This run was particularly hard to follow. The device was clearly very unideal, but the presentation of analysis and decision making was rarely clear.
final.biggest_wrong: I think it should have called for operator input earlier. Measurements at magnetic field were not well presented so it wasn't always clear what it was trying to do
